focus.name: player-terrain-exit-family
focus.purpose: Promote directional terrain-push, Type-0x4D paired-response, and Level-08 exit-presentation player-collision paths.

contracts.type08_09: consume the matching directional terrain-push latch, arm the four-frame terrain response, and raise the corresponding stop-motion flag when vertical/terrain motion requires it
contracts.type4d: update the paired Type-0x12 response actor, adjust PLAYER_VX by actor/player ordering, and install the Type-0x84 response actor
contracts.type60_61: publish the player position and landing/interaction state into the Level-08 exit-presentation actor and select the exit animation for Type 0x60
